user.title: Select your Hatch Rest
user.description: Select a discovered Rest, or enter its Bluetooth MAC address if it is missing from the list. Fill in only one field. Home Assistant must have seen the device through a connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy. The Rest can have its light and sound off, but it must be plugged in. Only the original, first-generation Hatch Rest is supported.

confirm.title: Connect Hatch Rest
confirm.description: Connect {name} ({address}). Close the Hatch Sleep app before continuing. Only the original, first-generation Hatch Rest is supported.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect. Close the Hatch Sleep app and make sure a connectable Home Assistant Bluetooth adapter or proxy is in range.
error.invalid_address: Enter a complete Bluetooth MAC address, such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.select_one_device: Select a discovered device or enter a Bluetooth MAC address. Fill in only one field.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Hatch Rest is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: A configuration flow for this Hatch Rest is already in progress.
abort.unsupported_device: This device does not use the supported first-generation Hatch Rest Bluetooth protocol. Rest+, Rest Mini, Restore, and second-generation devices are not supported.

polling.title: Hatch Rest updates
polling.description:
Choose how often to check for changes made with the Hatch app or Rest buttons. Each check briefly connects to the Rest, so shorter intervals use more Bluetooth capacity, especially with several devices on one proxy. When the Rest comes back into range after being unreachable, it is checked right away.

After a command, the connection can stay open briefly so follow-up commands are faster and button presses on the Rest appear immediately. While it is open, the Hatch app cannot connect. Use 0 to disconnect right after each command.

error.invalid_program_name: Use 1 to 16 printable ASCII characters. The name cannot be blank or one of OK, E01 through E06, or Unknown.
error.invalid_program_time: Enter a local time as HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.
error.invalid_program_duration: Choose a duration from 1 minute to 17 hours 59 minutes.
error.program_read_failed: Unable to read programs. Close the Hatch app, check Bluetooth range, and choose Refresh or Reload to retry.
error.program_write_failed: The Rest did not confirm the change. Reload its latest settings before trying again.
error.program_conflict: The program or slot changed on the Rest. Choose Reload, review the latest settings, and try again.
error.program_missing: This program is no longer on the Rest. Refresh the program list.
error.programs_full: All 10 program slots are in use. Delete an existing program before adding another.
error.confirmation_required: Select the confirmation checkbox to apply this change.
error.invalid_linger: Enter a whole number of seconds from 0 to 120.
